correctness.rationale: A fresh compatibility graph on all 32 binary words joined pairs at cyclic pair distance at least four. Independent Bron–Kerbosch enumeration found 118 maximal cliques, maximum size eight, and exactly 20 size-eight cliques. Translating each maximum by one of its words produced an eight-element set containing zero and closed under XOR, so every maximum is an affine three-dimensional subspace. Exactly five direction subspaces occur, each with four cosets. These checks reconstruct the finite classification from the metric definition; the known Singleton bound independently confirms the maximum-size ceiling.

originality.rationale: The classical symbol-pair literature already gives the Singleton upper bound and explicit binary MDS \((n,4)\) constructions for every \(n\ge4\), so neither existence nor the numerical maximum 8 is novel by itself. The inspected sources do not classify all nonlinear length-five binary maximizers. The audited census adds exactly that missing finite structure: all 20 labeled maxima are affine 3-flats, arranged as four cosets of five direction subspaces and one orbit under the stated pair-metric symmetry subgroup.

value.rationale: The smallest binary distance-four MDS symbol-pair instance is a canonical boundary case where existence was known but nonlinear extremizers were not classified. Determining every optimum, its affine rigidity, and its symmetry orbit gives a natural complete finite classification useful as a benchmark for structural conjectures and enumeration methods.

final_claim: Binary length-five symbol-pair codes with minimum pair distance at least four have maximum size eight; exactly 20 labeled maximum codes exist, every one is an affine three-flat in \(\mathbb F_2^5\), they are the four cosets of five cyclically related direction subspaces, and all 20 form one orbit under the stated 320-element pair-metric isometry subgroup.
limitations: The classification is specific to binary length five and pair distance four.
The MDS maximum size and existence were already known; originality is limited to the complete extremizer structure and counts.
